papers.title: PaperOrchestra: A Multi-Agent Framework for Automated AI Research Paper Writing
papers.tldr: PaperOrchestra is a multi-agent framework that converts unstructured research materials into complete LaTeX manuscripts with literature synthesis and visual elements, outperforming existing autonomous writing systems in human evaluations.

papers.title: Unlimited OCR Works
papers.tldr: Unlimited OCR introduces Reference Sliding Window Attention to eliminate growing memory consumption during long-sequence OCR tasks, enabling efficient transcription of multiple pages in a single forward pass.

papers.title: Depth Pro 2: Sharp and Temporally Consistent Metric Monocular Depth
papers.tldr: A single scalable network estimates dense metric depth for images and video at native resolution, jointly improving metric accuracy, boundary sharpness, and temporal consistency.

papers.title: Gamer: A Generalist Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Long-Horizon Real-Time Game Agent
papers.tldr: Gamer is a generalist agent framework that integrates perception, memory, and multi-step reasoning, trained through continued pre-training, sparse-thinking instruction tuning, and multi-turn reinforcement learning to interact efficiently in 2D and 3D environments.

papers.title: Harness^2: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World
papers.tldr: Harness² improves agent execution harnesses through recursive task-level refinement and continual harness-level learning, boosting performance across benchmarks without ground-truth verifiers.

papers.title: TradingAgents: Multi-Agents LLM Financial Trading Framework
papers.tldr: A multi-agent framework using large language models for stock trading simulates real-world trading firms, improving performance metrics like cumulative returns and Sharpe ratio.

papers.title: TokenEconomizer: Experience-Driven Black-Box Cost Control for Coding Agents
papers.tldr: TokenEconomizer reduces recurring token costs of coding agents across sequential real-world tasks by pruning irrelevant tools, injecting micro-skills, and interrupting failure loops.

papers.title: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention
papers.tldr: PagedAttention algorithm and vLLM system enhance the throughput of large language models by efficiently managing memory and reducing waste in the key-value cache.

papers.title: π^4: A Foundation Model for 4D Scene Geometry and Motion
papers.tldr: This unified foundation model enables the recovery of dense geometry, camera poses, and object tracking from diverse, uncalibrated observations in 4D scenes using a shared geometry and motion branch architecture.

papers.title: OpenDevin: An Open Platform for AI Software Developers as Generalist Agents
papers.tldr: OpenDevin is a platform for developing AI agents that interact with the world by writing code, using command lines, and browsing the web, with support for multiple agents and evaluation benchmarks.

papers.title: FreeToken: Efficient Edge-Native MoE Serving with Bandwidth-Adaptive Execution
papers.tldr: FreeToken is an edge-native Mixture-of-Experts serving system that dynamically maps computation and model state onto heterogeneous local hardware to run large open-weight models on personal machines.

papers.title: Bitnet.cpp: Efficient Edge Inference for Ternary LLMs
papers.tldr: Bitnet.cpp enhances edge inference for ternary LLMs using a novel mixed-precision matrix multiplication library, achieving significant speed improvements over baselines.

papers.title: The Other Half of the Memory Wall: Serving 35B MoEs from SSD with Trained Routing Prediction
papers.tldr: Edge0 enables efficient mixture-of-experts inference on consumer hardware by predicting expert routing ahead of time and using recovery adapters to maintain quality with minimal active memory.

papers.title: LittleBit: Ultra Low-Bit Quantization via Latent Factorization
papers.tldr: LittleBit is a novel method for extreme compression of large language models using low-rank factorization and multi-scale compensation, achieving significant memory reduction and performance in sub-1-bit quantization.

papers.title: Very Large-Scale Multi-Agent Simulation in AgentScope
papers.tldr: Enhancements to the AgentScope platform improve scalability, efficiency, and ease of use for large-scale multi-agent simulations through distributed mechanisms, flexible environments, and user-friendly tools.

papers.title: AgentScope 1.0: A Developer-Centric Framework for Building Agentic Applications
papers.tldr: AgentScope enhances agentic applications by providing flexible tool-based interactions, unified interfaces, and advanced infrastructure based on the ReAct paradigm, supporting efficient and safe development and deployment.

papers.title: MinerU2.5: A Decoupled Vision-Language Model for Efficient High-Resolution Document Parsing
papers.tldr: MinerU2.5, a 1.2B-parameter document parsing vision-language model, achieves state-of-the-art recognition accuracy with computational efficiency through a coarse-to-fine parsing strategy.

papers.title: Geometric Context Transformer for Streaming 3D Reconstruction
papers.tldr: LingBot-Map is a feed-forward 3D foundation model that reconstructs scenes from video streams using a geometric context transformer architecture with specialized attention mechanisms for coordinate grounding, dense geometric cues, and long-range drift correction, achieving stable real-time performance at 20 FPS.

papers.title: MovieRoll: A Systematic Framework for Rolling Out Long-Form Videos
papers.tldr: Streaming video generation must sustain quality beyond the training horizon while handling self-generated history and growing cache costs.

papers.title: MedJev: A System One Vision-Language Decision Model for Fast and Effective Medical Image Understanding
papers.tldr: Medical image understanding with vision-language models (VLMs) typically relies on autoregressively generating reasoning and answer tokens.
